notes.title: AWS Update
notes.notes:
Hi all!

It's been a long time!
This update is to bring all the AWS (Amazon) API calls up to date. I also need to do this to the mobile versions. 

So since I've had to dust all the code off and give it some love, I'm thinking of adding some small content updates. Let me know if you have any ideas.

Cheers,
Steve
